title: Memory-Free Continual Learning with Null Space Adaptation for Zero-Shot Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2510.21175v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot generalization, enabling deployment in a wide range of real-world tasks without additional task-specific training. However, in real deployment scenarios with evolving environments or emerging classes, these models inevitably face distributional shifts and novel tasks. In such contexts, static zero-shot capabilities are insufficient, and there is a growing need for continual learning methods that allow models to adapt over time while avoiding catastrophic forgetting. We introduce NuSA-CL (Null Space Adaptation for Continual Learning), a lightweight memory-free continual learning framework designed to address this challenge. NuSA-CL employs low-rank adaptation and constrains task-specific weight updates to lie within an approximate null space of the model's current parameters. translated_title: 基于零空间适应的无记忆持续学习方法用于零样本视觉语言模型
translated_abstract: 预训练的视觉语言模型（VLM），如CLIP，已展现出卓越的零样本泛化能力，使其无需额外的任务特定训练即可部署于广泛的现实世界任务中。然而，在环境不断演变或出现新类别的实际部署场景中，这些模型不可避免地面临分布偏移和新任务。在这种情况下，静态的零样本能力已不足以应对，因此越来越需要持续学习方法，使模型能够随时间进行适应，同时避免灾难性遗忘。我们提出了NuSA-CL（用于持续学习的零空间适应），这是一个轻量级的无记忆持续学习框架，旨在解决这一挑战。NuSA-CL采用低秩适应，并将任务特定的权重更新约束在模型当前参数的近似零空间内。这一策略最大限度地减少了对先前已获取知识的干扰。
tldr: 提出了NuSA-CL框架，通过低秩适应将任务特定权重更新约束在模型参数的近似零空间内，使视觉语言模型在无需存储记忆的情况下实现持续学习并避免灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: Proposes NuSA-CL, a lightweight memory-free continual learning framework that constrains low-rank task-specific weight updates within the approximate null space of the model's current parameters, enabling vision-language models to adapt to new tasks while avoiding catastrophic forgetting.
